eyebrow: The whole rule in one line
code:
effective access =
  profile
  UNION every assigned permission set
  UNION every permission set in every assigned group

-- any ONE grant is enough. nothing subtracts.
caption: No "most restrictive wins." No "last one applied wins." Just union.
